members.name: show
members.description: Determines whether to show or hide the below, or above bar area.

members.name: color
members.description:
If provided, this [`BarAreaData`](#barareadata) fills the area with this `color`.
Otherwise we use `gradient` to fill it.
It throws an exception if you provide both `color` and `gradient`.

Defaults to a semi-transparent [`Colors.blueGrey`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/material/Colors-class.html) if neither `color` nor
`gradient` is provided.

members.name: gradient
members.description:
If provided, this [`BarAreaData`](#barareadata) fills the area with this `gradient`.
Otherwise we use `color` to fill it.
It throws an exception if you provide both `color` and `gradient`.

You can use any [`Gradient`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/painting/Gradient-class.html) here, such as [`LinearGradient`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/painting/LinearGradient-class.html) or [`RadialGradient`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/painting/RadialGradient-class.html).

members.name: spotsLine
members.description:
Holds data for drawing a line from each spot to the bottom, or top of
the chart, see [`BarAreaSpotsLine`](#barareaspotsline).

members.name: cutOffY
members.description:
Cuts the drawing of the below or above area at this y value
(set `applyCutOffY` to true to apply it).

members.name: applyCutOffY
members.description: Determines whether to apply `cutOffY`.

members.name: show
members.description: Determines to show or hide all the lines.

members.name: flLineStyle
members.description: Holds appearance of drawing line on the spots.

members.name: checkToShowSpotLine
members.description: Checks to show or hide lines on the spots.

members.name: applyCutOffY
members.description: Determines to inherit the cutOff properties from its parent [`BarAreaData`](#barareadata)

members.name: fromIndex
members.description:
Index of the first [`LineChartBarData`](#linechartbardata) in [`LineChartData.lineBarsData`](#linechartdata)
(zero-based), the area is filled from this line.

members.name: toIndex
members.description:
Index of the second [`LineChartBarData`](#linechartbardata) in [`LineChartData.lineBarsData`](#linechartdata)
(zero-based), the area is filled up to this line.

members.name: color
members.description:
If provided, this [`BetweenBarsData`](#betweenbarsdata) fills the area with this `color`.
Otherwise we use `gradient` to fill it.
It throws an exception if you provide both `color` and `gradient`.

Defaults to a semi-transparent [`Colors.blueGrey`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/material/Colors-class.html) if neither `color` nor
`gradient` is provided.

members.name: gradient
members.description:
If provided, this [`BetweenBarsData`](#betweenbarsdata) fills the area with this `gradient`.
Otherwise we use `color` to fill it.
It throws an exception if you provide both `color` and `gradient`.

You can use any [`Gradient`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/painting/Gradient-class.html) here, such as [`LinearGradient`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/painting/LinearGradient-class.html) or [`RadialGradient`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/painting/RadialGradient-class.html).

members.name: show
members.description: Determines show or hide all dots.

members.name: checkToShowDot
members.description: Checks to show or hide an individual dot.

members.name: getDotPainter
members.description:
Callback which is called to set the painter of the given [`FlSpot`](base_chart.md#flspot).
The [`FlSpot`](base_chart.md#flspot) is provided as parameter to this callback

members.name: bar
members.description: Is the [`LineChartBarData`](#linechartbardata) that this spot is inside of.

members.name: barIndex
members.description: Is the index of our `bar`, in the [`LineChartData.lineBarsData`](#linechartdata) list.

members.name: spotIndex
members.description: Is the index of this spot, in the [`LineChartBarData.spots`](#linechartbardata) list.

members.name: spots
members.description:
This line goes through this spots.

You can have multiple lines by splitting them,
put a [`FlSpot.nullSpot`](base_chart.md#flspot) between each section.

members.name: show
members.description: Determines to show or hide the line.

members.name: color
members.description:
If provided, this [`LineChartBarData`](#linechartbardata) draws with this `color`.
Otherwise we use `gradient` to draw the line.
It throws an exception if you provide both `color` and `gradient`.

Defaults to [`Colors.cyan`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/material/Colors-class.html) if neither `color` nor `gradient` is provided.

members.name: gradient
members.description:
If provided, this [`LineChartBarData`](#linechartbardata) draws with this `gradient`.
Otherwise we use `color` to draw the line.
It throws an exception if you provide both `color` and `gradient`.

You can use any [`Gradient`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/painting/Gradient-class.html) here, such as [`LinearGradient`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/painting/LinearGradient-class.html) or [`RadialGradient`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/painting/RadialGradient-class.html).

members.name: gradientArea
members.description:
Only effective if `gradient` is provided.

It will be used to determine the area of the gradient.

members.name: barWidth
members.description: Determines thickness of drawing line.

members.name: isCurved
members.description:
If it's true, [`LineChart`](https://pub.dev/documentation/fl_chart/latest/fl_chart/LineChart-class.html) draws the line with curved edges,
otherwise it draws line with hard edges.

members.name: curveSmoothness
members.description: If `isCurved` is true, it determines smoothness of the curved edges.

members.name: preventCurveOverShooting
members.description:
Prevents overshooting when drawing a curve line on linear sequence spots,
check this [issue](https://github.com/imaNNeo/fl_chart/issues/25).

members.name: preventCurveOvershootingThreshold
members.description: Applies threshold for `preventCurveOverShooting` algorithm.

members.name: isStrokeCapRound
members.description:
If true, the start and end of the line are round ([`StrokeCap.round`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/dart-ui/StrokeCap.html)),
otherwise they are flat ([`StrokeCap.butt`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/dart-ui/StrokeCap.html)).

members.name: isStrokeJoinRound
members.description:
If true, the corners of the line are round ([`StrokeJoin.round`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/dart-ui/StrokeJoin.html)),
otherwise they are sharp ([`StrokeJoin.miter`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/dart-ui/StrokeJoin.html)).

members.name: belowBarData
members.description: Fills the space below the line, using a color or gradient, see [`BarAreaData`](#barareadata).

members.name: aboveBarData
members.description: Fills the space above the line, using a color or gradient, see [`BarAreaData`](#barareadata).

members.name: dotData
members.description: Responsible for showing `spots` on the line as dots, see [`FlDotData`](#fldotdata).

members.name: errorIndicatorData
members.description:
Holds data for showing error indicators on the spots in this line
(they are shown if you provide [`FlSpot.xError`](base_chart.md#flspot) or [`FlSpot.yError`](base_chart.md#flspot)).

members.name: showingIndicators
members.description:
Shows indicators (a thicker line and a larger dot) on the spots at
the provided indices.

members.name: dashArray
members.description:
Draws the line dashed, it's a circular array of dash lengths and gaps.

For example, `[5, 10]` results in dashes 5 pixels long followed by
gaps 10 pixels long, and `[5, 10, 5]` results in a 5 pixel dash,
a 10 pixel gap, a 5 pixel dash, a 5 pixel gap, a 10 pixel dash, etc.

members.name: shadow
members.description: Drops a [`Shadow`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/dart-ui/Shadow-class.html) behind the line.

members.name: isStepLineChart
members.description: If sets true, it draws the chart in Step Line Chart style, using [`LineChartBarData.lineChartStepData`](#linechartbardata).

members.name: lineChartStepData
members.description: Holds data for representing a Step Line Chart, and works only if `isStepLineChart` is true.

members.name: lineBarsData
members.description:
List of [`LineChartBarData`](#linechartbardata) to show the chart's lines, they stack and
can be drawn on top of each other.

members.name: betweenBarsData
members.description: Fills area between two [`LineChartBarData`](#linechartbardata) with a color or gradient.

members.name: titlesData
members.description: Holds data to draw the titles around the chart, see [`FlTitlesData`](base_chart.md#fltitlesdata).

members.name: extraLinesData
members.description:
Extra horizontal or vertical lines to draw on the chart,
see [`ExtraLinesData`](base_chart.md#extralinesdata).

members.name: lineTouchData
members.description: Handles touch behaviors and responses.

members.name: showingTooltipIndicators
members.description:
You can show some tooltipIndicators (a popup with an information)
on top of each [`LineChartBarData.spots`](#linechartbardata) using `showingTooltipIndicators`,
just put line indicator number and spots indices you want to show it on top of them.

An important point is that you have to disable the default touch behaviour
to show the tooltip manually, see [`LineTouchData.handleBuiltInTouches`](#linetouchdata-read-about-touch-handling).

members.name: gridData
members.description: Holds data to draw the grid lines behind the chart, see [`FlGridData`](base_chart.md#flgriddata).

members.name: borderData
members.description: Holds data to draw the border around the chart, see [`FlBorderData`](base_chart.md#flborderdata).

members.name: rangeAnnotations
members.description:
Highlights some horizontal or vertical ranges behind the chart,
see [`RangeAnnotations`](base_chart.md#rangeannotations).

members.name: minX
members.description:
Minimum x value of the chart. If you don't provide it, it is calculated
from the chart's data (providing it is more performant).

members.name: maxX
members.description:
Maximum x value of the chart. If you don't provide it, it is calculated
from the chart's data (providing it is more performant).

members.name: baselineX
members.description:
The x value that the vertical grid lines and the titles are aligned to,
they are drawn at every `baselineX + n * interval`.

members.name: minY
members.description:
Minimum y value of the chart. If you don't provide it, it is calculated
from the chart's data (providing it is more performant).

members.name: maxY
members.description:
Maximum y value of the chart. If you don't provide it, it is calculated
from the chart's data (providing it is more performant).

members.name: baselineY
members.description:
The y value that the horizontal grid lines and the titles are aligned to,
they are drawn at every `baselineY + n * interval`.

members.name: clipData
members.description:
Clips the chart to its border (prevents drawing outside of the border),
see [`FlClipData`](https://pub.dev/documentation/fl_chart/latest/fl_chart/FlClipData-class.html).

members.name: backgroundColor
members.description: A background color which is drawn behind the chart.

members.name: rotationQuarterTurns
members.description:
Rotates the chart 90 degrees (clockwise) in every quarter turn.
It works like the [`RotatedBox`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/widgets/RotatedBox-class.html) widget.

members.name: rectAroundTheLine
members.description:
The gradient area will be around the line only, meaning
the gradient will exactly wrap around the curve.

members.name: wholeChart
members.description: The entire chart area will be used as the gradient area for the curve.

members.name: stepDirection
members.description:
Determines the direction of each step, between 0.0 ([`stepDirectionForward`](#linechartstepdata))
and 1.0 ([`stepDirectionBackward`](#linechartstepdata)).

members.name: text
members.description: Text of this row in the tooltip bubble.

members.name: textStyle
members.description: [`TextStyle`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/painting/TextStyle-class.html) of the text.

members.name: textAlign
members.description: [`TextAlign`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/dart-ui/TextAlign.html) of the text.

members.name: textDirection
members.description: [`TextDirection`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/dart-ui/TextDirection.html) of the text.

members.name: children
members.description: Additional [`TextSpan`](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/painting/TextSpan-class.html)s after `text`, for a more advanced tooltip.

members.name: enabled
members.description: Determines whether to enable or disable touch behaviors.

members.name: touchCallback
members.description:
`touchCallback` notifies you about the happened touch/pointer events.
It gives you a [`FlTouchEvent`](base_chart.md#fltouchevent) which is the happened event such as [`FlPointerHoverEvent`](https://pub.dev/documentation/fl_chart/latest/fl_chart/FlPointerHoverEvent-class.html), [`FlTapUpEvent`](https://pub.dev/documentation/fl_chart/latest/fl_chart/FlTapUpEvent-class.html), ...
It also gives you a [`BaseTouchResponse`](https://pub.dev/documentation/fl_chart/latest/fl_chart/BaseTouchResponse-class.html) which is the chart specific type and contains information
about the elements that has touched.

members.name: mouseCursorResolver
members.description:
Using `mouseCursorResolver` you can change the mouse cursor
based on the provided [`FlTouchEvent`](base_chart.md#fltouchevent) and [`BaseTouchResponse`](https://pub.dev/documentation/fl_chart/latest/fl_chart/BaseTouchResponse-class.html)

members.name: longPressDuration
members.description:
This property that allows to customize the duration of the longPress gesture.
If null, it uses [kLongPressTimeout](https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/gestures/kLongPressTimeout-constant.html) (500 milliseconds).

members.name: touchTooltipData
members.description:
Determines how the tooltip looks on top of the touched spots,
see [`LineTouchTooltipData`](#linetouchtooltipdata).

members.name: getTouchedSpotIndicator
members.description:
Retrieves a list of [`TouchedSpotIndicatorData`](#touchedspotindicatordata) for the touched spots
of a line, to show an indicator on each of them.

members.name: touchSpotThreshold
members.description: Distance threshold to handle the touch event.

members.name: distanceCalculator
members.description:
Calculates the distance between a touch point and a spot, to find the
closest spots to the touch. By default, only the horizontal distance
is used.

members.name: handleBuiltInTouches
members.description:
If true, the chart handles touches by itself: it shows a tooltip
bubble and an indicator on the touched spots.

members.name: getTouchLineStart
members.description:
The starting point on y axis of the touch line. By default, line starts on the bottom of
the chart.

members.name: getTouchLineEnd
members.description:
The end point on y axis of the touch line. By default, line ends at the touched point.
If line end is overlap with the dot, it will be automatically adjusted to the edge of the dot.

members.name: touchLocation
members.description: The location of the touch in pixels on the screen.

members.name: touchChartCoordinate
members.description: The axis coordinate of the touch in chart's coordinate system.

members.name: lineBarSpots
members.description:
touch happened on these spots
(if a single line provided on the chart, `lineBarSpots`'s length will be 1 always)

members.name: tooltipBorderRadius
members.description: Sets a rounded radius for the tooltip.

members.name: tooltipPadding
members.description: Applies a padding for showing contents inside the tooltip.

members.name: tooltipMargin
members.description: Margin between the tooltip and the touched spot.

members.name: tooltipHorizontalAlignment
members.description: Controls showing tooltip on left side, right side or center aligned with spot.

members.name: tooltipHorizontalOffset
members.description: Applies horizontal offset for showing tooltip.

members.name: maxContentWidth
members.description:
Maximum width of the tooltip's content, a text row which is wider than
this breaks into a new line.

members.name: getTooltipItems
members.description:
Retrieves a [`LineTooltipItem`](#linetooltipitem) for each touched spot, to show as a row
inside the tooltip.

members.name: getTooltipColor
members.description: Retrieves the background color of the tooltip for each touched spot.

members.name: fitInsideHorizontally
members.description: Forces the tooltip to shift horizontally inside the chart, if overflow happens.

members.name: fitInsideVertically
members.description: Forces the tooltip to shift vertically inside the chart, if overflow happens.

members.name: showOnTopOfTheChartBoxArea
members.description:
Forces the tooltip container to the top of the chart's box area,
instead of on top of the touched spots.

members.name: rotateAngle
members.description: Controls the rotation of the tooltip.

members.name: tooltipBorder
members.description: Border of the tooltip bubble.

members.name: showingSpots
members.description: Determines the spots that each tooltip should be shown.

members.name: distance
members.description: Distance in pixels from where the user tapped.

members.name: indicatorBelowLine
members.description: The line drawn below the touched spot, see [`FlLine`](base_chart.md#flline).

members.name: touchedSpotDotData
members.description: The dot drawn on the touched spot, see [`FlDotData`](#fldotdata).
